newsitem.title: USA: API says U.S. crude stocks fell in week.
newsitem.headline: API says U.S. crude stocks fell in week.

text.p: U.S. crude oil stocks held in primary storage fell 3.50 million barrels in the week ended Nov 15 to 302.31 million barrels from 305.81 million barrels the prior week, the American Petroleum Institute (API) said Tuesday.
API said that crude stocks excluding PADD 5 (Petroleum Administration for Defense District) fell 298,000 barrels in the week to 242.45 million barrels from 242.75 million.
Distillate stocks rose 920,000 barrels to 117.56 million from 116.64 million the prior week. PADD 1 distillate stocks rose 1.87 million barrels to 46.88 million from 45.01 million.
API said gasoline stocks fell 535,000 barrels in the week to 187.34 million barrels from 187.88 million barrels. Percent of capacity rose to 92.9 percent from 90.7 percent.
API said reformulated gasoline stocks (RFG) rose 773,000 barrels to 37.38 million barrels from 36.61 million barrels in the previous week.
API said crude runs to processing units rose to 14.16 million barrels from 13.74 million barrels.
Residual fuel stocks in the latest week rose to 38.87 million barrels from 38.71 million in the previous week, but crude oil imports fell to 6.92 million barrels per day from 8.11 million, API said.
